messages:
maria: FYI we hit a subtle parity/UX problem while integrating the sample pagination helper into the onboarding flow. Node SDK prefetch cancels inflight page reads differently than python-sdk, causing duplicate reads when auth refresh happens mid-stream.
aj: can you paste the repro steps? sounds like a race between cursor persistence and retry.
maria: repro: start convo flow that prefetches 3 pages, concurrency 4. Force an auth refresh (short STS TTL) during page 2 fetch. Node logs show a retry that re-reads page 1 cursor was not checkpointed because page 2 hadn't confirmed. python-sdk checkpoints earlier and cancels in-flight page requests on auth start.
maria: node snippet from sampleapp:

maria: ```js
await forEachPage({ prefetch: 3, concurrency: 4 }, async (page, ctx) => {
  // save cursor after page processed
  await saveCursor(ctx.nextCursor)
})
```

maria: logs (node):

maria: ```
[12:34:11.120] INFO page.fetch id=px-7 page=1
[12:34:11.341] INFO token.refresh start
[12:34:11.520] ERROR 429 page.fetch id=px-7 page=1 retrying
[12:34:11.521] INFO page.fetch id=px-8 page=1  <-- duplicate read
[12:34:12.02] INFO cursor.save skipped (page 2 not complete)
```

nina: interesting. so node kept the working item in-flight and retried, which then duplicated page 1 reads since cursor wasn't advanced. python cancels the inflight page when it detects auth rotation.

maria: exactly. two problems: (1) Node SDK doesn't expose an easy per-request abort signal for the sample prefetch helper to cancel inflight page fetches when auth refresh or quota throttle happens; (2) our sampleapp's cursor checkpointing happens only after page processing, which is normal, but combined with prefetch and lack of canceling it amplifies duplicates.
dev-bot: Incident bot: rate-limit surge detected for sampleapp-onboard at 2026-03-16T08:15:30Z, 429s increased 3x :warning:

aj: proposed fixes:
- Node SDK: add per-request AbortController integration and a retry hook that supports jittered backoff with small randomization by default.
- Sample helper: change checkpointing strategy to optimistic checkpoint after enqueue + durable dedupe by request id.
- Add optional prefetch lease: when prefetch worker takes a page it acquires a short lease so other workers won't re-read until lease expires or ACK. This prevents duplicate work on transient retries.

maria: I like the lease idea. less intrusive than cancelling everything. we can combine: lease + cancel on auth start.

tom: can we also have the SDK attach request-id to logs and the lease token in headers? makes triage easy.

maria: agreed. I'll open two PRs: sampleapp change + quick Node SDK small API to accept AbortSignal and optional lease hook.

nina: tests: add a unit test that simulates auth rotation mid-prefetch and asserts no duplicate page processing and that cursor moves forward once.

aj: for parity, we'll include the same behavior in python-sdk but keep it opt-in behind a flag for one release to ensure no unexpected perf shift.

maria: action items: maria -> PR sampleapp (prefetch+lease) (link forthcoming), aj -> SDK issue and proposal for AbortSignal + default jitter, nina -> write test harness for auth-rotation scenario, tom -> add request-id + lease-token to logs. We'll run the full perf suite after changes.

dev-bot: CI: sampleapp tests triggered by maria/samples/prefetch-lease at 2026-03-16T08:20:00Z :gear:

maria: thanks. this hit looks like a real DX trap for customers doing aggressive prefetching on short-lived tokens. we should add a short note to onboarding docs warning about token rotation + prefetch and recommended defaults (prefetch=1, concurrency <=3) until SDK patch lands.

tom: noted. I'll add a tiny blurb in the quickstart and link SDK issue once created.

aj: thanks all. nice catch.
